# Compound Policy Statements — Test Reference
# These are human-readable examples; actual test data is inline in unit tests.

# AC-1: Two-part compound with "and must"
Systems must enforce MFA and must require complex passwords
→ Expected: 2 atomic requirements
  1. "Systems must enforce MFA"
  2. "Systems must require complex passwords"

# AC-2: Two-part compound with "and shall" + shared subject
The organization shall review access logs and shall revoke inactive accounts within 30 days
→ Expected: 2 atomic requirements
  1. "The organization shall review access logs"
  2. "The organization shall revoke inactive accounts within 30 days"

# AC-3: Three-part compound with mixed conjunctions
All employees must complete security training and must acknowledge the acceptable use policy or must request a waiver
→ Expected: 3 atomic requirements
  1. "All employees must complete security training"
  2. "All employees must acknowledge the acceptable use policy"
  3. "All employees must request a waiver"

# EC-2: "or" conjunction with normative verbs
Systems must implement MFA or must use certificate-based authentication
→ Expected: 2 atomic requirements

# EC-6: "shall" normative verb
The team shall document procedures and shall train all staff
→ Expected: 2 atomic requirements
